title: POST /api/sales/cancel — request body
description: Cancels an unpaid sale previously accepted by POST /api/sales/ingest (owner decisions O-07 / O-08). Headers: Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token> (client accounts only), x-verification-receipt: <timestampMs>.<hex HMAC-SHA256(networkSecret, timestampMs + '.' + canonical)> with canonical = JSON.stringify({saleId, uid, cancellationId, cancelledMs, reason}) in exactly that key order (saleId = saleUuid, uid from the token). Same ±5 min skew and current/previous key candidates as ingest. Identity, commission and settlement fields are server-owned and rejected (client_identity_field_forbidden / client_financial_field_forbidden / client_field_forbidden). Client rule: cancellationId = 'cxl_' + first 32 hex chars of sha256('sale_cancel:' + saleUuid); cancelledMs is stored on first detection and resent unchanged on every retry; it may not be more than 24h in the future (cancelled_at_in_future). Responses: 200 CANCELLED (reversedAmountRiyal, reversedCommissionRiyal, policyVersion 2), 200 ALREADY_CANCELLED_ACKED (idempotent by sale; returns the stored cancellationId), 404 sale_not_found, 409 sale_already_settled (recorded in sale_cancellation_registry for admin review), 409 sale_not_cancellable.
